jobs.tierReason: Recheck of a sensitive/high-risk ticket after fixes for the prior review's findings.
jobs.prompt:
Recheck T-0176 (tools/cluster-client.mjs) after fixes for a prior Opus review's findings: (1) added AbortSignal.timeout + mapped AbortError to 'cluster-request-timeout'; (2) added redirect:'error'; (3) added assertClusterCanonicalHost + buildClusterLedgerUrl validating hostname/pathname/no-credentials via new URL(); (4) wrapped readNodeRegistry in try/catch rethrowing a fixed 'cluster-registry-invalid' message; (5) added isStrongNodeSecret requiring 32+ hex or base64url chars. Confirm each of the 5 fixes actually closes the finding it targets, with no new gap introduced (e.g. does the host regex actually reject 'evil.example/x#' and 'trusted@evil.example'; does the timeout actually cover the res.text() read too; is the registry's raw error message never reachable from the thrown error). Report only real, concretely demonstrable remaining problems with file and line.
Finish with exactly one JSON line: {"reviews":[{"ticket":"T-0176","verdict":"pass"|"fail","findings":[...]}]}. Use "fail" only for a genuine remaining high or medium finding.

jobs.tierReason: Recheck of a sensitive/high-risk ticket after fixes for the prior review's findings.
jobs.prompt:
Recheck T-0410 (tools/queue-commands.mjs claim routing) after fixes for a prior Opus review's findings: (1) isolatedGrantSpec is now validated BEFORE claim() runs, so a missing-env-value failure never touches the lease; (2) createJobGrant is wrapped in try/catch, and on failure the code now calls release(root, result.ticketId, result.fencingToken, {now}) to roll back the just-acquired lease before rethrowing; (3) readQueueProject's project-read now falls back to {} on any failure so legacy/non-isolated claims are unaffected. Confirm: the release() call actually uses the correct ticketId/fencingToken to release THIS job's own lease (not some other); the rollback path is actually exercised by the new test, not just asserted in prose; a legacy (non-isolated) project's claim output/exit code is truly unchanged from before. Report only real, concretely demonstrable remaining problems with file and line.
Finish with exactly one JSON line: {"reviews":[{"ticket":"T-0410","verdict":"pass"|"fail","findings":[...]}]}. Use "fail" only for a genuine remaining high or medium finding.
